decisions.issues: v02 is clean. It is a wide storm-grey beach with black rock outcrops and timber in the surf. Nagoji lies small and face down in the foam with his arms flung out and bandaged wrists, and a frayed rope end trails from him, which matches 1.2. There are no irons, chain or collar, and plenty of empty sky for the caption. v01 is not acceptable. It crops Nagoji large in the foreground rather than small in the foam, which breaks the wide establishing beat. It also leaves his hands and wrists unbandaged, which contradicts the bandaged fingers in 1.2.
decisions.erase_note: v03 is an erase-only edit of v02 (painted balloons removed); tails, faces and keep zones inherited

decisions.issues: v04 fits the script beat best: a ground-level shot tight on both bandaged hands clawed into wet grit. The fingers are wrapped and the backs of the hands and wrists are raw red. The left forearm (image right) is heavily crusted with sand and shows no readable mark. The torn ochre tunic hangs open, a rope loop crosses the chest, and the free end trails off into the foam at right. His knees and dhoti sit in the retreating surf. There are no irons, collar, painted text or blood. The face is cropped at the nose, so the eyes stay for 1.3's close-up. What shows matches the sheet: thick curled moustache, clean-shaven stubbled chin, gold ear stud, loose curly hair. Minor flaws: each hand shows only four digits, but one finger reads as buried in the grit, which suits 'dug into' the sand. Only one rope loop is visible where the script asks for two, and he is braced on straight arms rather than slumped. The caption fits the clear sky at top right (about x 0.72-1.0, y 0-0.18). Backup v03 has cleaner five-digit hands and correct identity. Its weaknesses are framing and sequence: it is a wider medium shot, not tight on the hands, and it shows his full face alert and looking off. That pre-empts 1.3's close-up of his cheek pressed to the sand with one eye half open.

Minor only. The right side of the moustache droops down toward the sand instead of curling up, which reads as wet hair pressed flat, not a beard. The cheek and jaw are clean and the chin is pressed into the sand. The shoulder and back mass is soft but reads as a man lying face down. The rope loops on the torso sit on the shoulder and ribs, well clear of the neck, which matches 1.2. The caption fits over the grey sky and distant surf at the top left, clear of the face.

In v01 the lower legs run up to about knee height at the top edge, behind where the balloons sit. Nothing else of the men shows. The light shifts to a low sun breaking under grey storm cloud, which still sits well beside the grey sky of 2.1. Otherwise it matches the beat: the same low angle along the sand, a moved tide line, and three pairs of bare brown feet walking in from the right edge and leaving a trail of prints. Toe counts and anatomy are sound, and the open sky at left and centre takes the caption and the off-panel voices. Rejected: v02 has only five feet, and the legs are cut off by a hard horizontal line under the balloon. v03 has five disembodied feet ending at the ankle in mid-air. v04 shows only two pairs of legs. v06 shows four feet stacked in a column with no legs. v05 is the backup: three sound pairs of feet, but they stand still in the shallows rather than approaching with a trail of prints, and there is no horizon or sky to show the time shift.
decisions.tails_note: v07 (clean): the selection's own points, above the approaching feet; backup v01 keeps the points above its painted balloons
decisions.erase_note: v07 is an erase-only edit of v01 (painted balloons removed); tails, faces and keep zones inherited

decisions.issues: v03 is clean. It is Nagoji's point of view looking up into a grey sky, and the three faces ring the frame. The Fisherman has a short grizzled beard, white teeth and the white cloth on his LEFT shoulder. The Young Fisherman is inverted at the top, with a headband, a thin black beard and a blue cloth over one bare shoulder. The Wary Fisherman has a long grey-streaked beard and a net coil, and his eyes are turned away. There is no painted text. Open sky at the top left and the bottom centre has room for the caption. v02 is nearly identical, but the Young Fisherman wears a blue sleeveless vest over both shoulders. That contradicts the chapter costume (bare-chested, no vests), so it is not used as backup.

v04 is acceptable. The Fisherman is bare-chested, with a short grizzled beard, a red lungi and a white cloth hanging from his left shoulder. He pushes Nagoji's hair back. Nagoji flinches, with a bandaged hand half raised to his face. The rope loops are across his chest and no forearm mark is readable. Nagoji has a thick moustache, a clean-shaven chin with faint stubble and a gold ear stud. The setting is the same stormy beach with black rocks. Minor: Nagoji's moustache ends droop more than curl. His raised arm is folded sharply and carries two bandage bands, but it reads correctly. Room for the speech balloon: open sky at the top right or top left. Room for the caption: low-detail cream dhoti at the bottom left. v03 is not acceptable because the Fisherman wears a cream sleeveless vest (chapter costume is bare-chested, no vests).

v02 is acceptable. Water pours from a clay pot into Nagoji's mouth and runs down his clean-shaven chin. His moustache and gold stud match the sheet, rope burns show on his chest, and the background is empty surf. A fisherman's brown arm and cream vest are visible, and the second hand under the pot is plausible. The framing is a medium close-up rather than truly tight, and the pot pours at his lips rather than being pressed to them. That is acceptable. No rope is visible on the chest, which fits because 2.4 shows the rope already cut away. Rejected v01: Portuguese soldiers in morions stand in the background with a fort, the pot is held by a man in a European doublet and belt (the beat is 'They were not Portuguese'), and the brand is shown on his forearm too early.
decisions.erase_note: v03 is an erase-only edit of v02 (painted balloons removed); tails, faces and keep zones inherited

decisions.issues: v05 is acceptable and is the only candidate where the fishermen are bare-chested. The view is from behind Nagoji's left shoulder: he is propped on his left elbow, the forearm lies flat on the sand, and the gold ear stud shows. There is no rope or iron on him, and the cut rope loops lie beside him. The Fisherman wears a red lungi with a white cloth on his LEFT shoulder. The Young Fisherman wears an indigo lungi, a blue shoulder cloth and a headband, and slides a knife into his waist-knot. The Wary Fisherman wears an off-white lungi, a brown shoulder cloth and a net. Behind them are black rocks and palms, the broken ship's boat with scattered planks on the right, and the dismasted black ship heeled over on the reef. There is no painted text. Minor issues: (1) Nagoji's right hand, half hidden under his chest, is unbandaged. (2) The upper side of his left forearm has a whitish lacy crust that reads as salt or sand, not letters or a brand. (3) The Fisherman's beard is thinner than in 2.1 and 2.2. Large open storm sky at the top right has room for the caption. v04 is not acceptable because all three fishermen wear sleeveless vests.

v01 is clean. It is a narrow surf-line strip of foam, floating planks and a torn scrap of sail on a spar, with black rocks at right matching the rest of the page. No human figure appears anywhere, and two clear sky areas take the two captions. Rejected v02: the bottom third of the frame is a blank white area, so the image is broken.
decisions.erase_note: v03 is an erase-only edit of v01 (painted balloons removed); tails, faces and keep zones inherited

decisions.issues: Minor only. Nagoji's left foot has a hand-style bandage with toes showing. The Young Fisherman's indigo lungi hangs full length instead of being hitched to the thigh, and his blue cloth drapes across much of his torso. The sky for lettering is a fairly shallow band: top-left above the wreck, and top centre-right above the palms. Nagoji is on-model: clean-shaven chin, thick moustache, gold stud, rope burns, no rope. The Young Fisherman holds the right hand at Nagoji's right, and the Fisherman scrapes sand from the left forearm at Nagoji's left. The forearm mark cannot be read. v06 is almost the same frame but puts both fishermen in sleeveless vests, which breaks the bare-chested costume rule, so there is no backup.

Clean. This is a real tight insert, not a crop. The brand on the inner forearm, above the soaked wrist bandage, is a puckered patch of ridged scar tissue with no legible letters, numerals or cross, and no blood. The Fisherman's sandy thumb is scraping wet sand at the left edge. The ochre tunic, cream dhoti and grey surf behind match 3.1. No lettering needed.

Minor. He stands calf to knee deep in the surf rather than ankle-deep. The other men are not shown, which suits 'stands apart'. The Wary Fisherman is gaunt and bare-chested, with a long grey-streaked beard, an off-white lungi, a dark brown cloth and the net over his shoulder. He glances up toward the wreck. The large sky gives plenty of room for the caption and two balloons. v06 puts him in a brown sleeveless vest, against the no-vest rule, so there is no backup.

Fix landed. A pixel diff against v07 shows only Nagoji's hands changed. In v08 every finger on both hands is wrapped in bandage, and the fingers read as separate wrapped digits. The only bare skin is a speck at one fingertip on his left hand, which is negligible. Nothing else got worse: same beach, sky, wreck and figures as v07. The Fisherman is bare-chested in a red lungi with a white shoulder cloth, crouched and turned toward the Wary Fisherman with a haggling open hand. The Wary Fisherman stands at the tide line in an off-white lungi with a net on his shoulder. Nagoji matches his sheet: thick curled moustache, clean chin with light captivity stubble, gold ear ornament, torn ochre tunic, cream dhoti, rope burns on chest. There is no painted text, no blood and no anachronism. The tan blotch on the bandage is sand or dirt, not red. The large overcast sky across the top gives room for all three Fisherman balloons. Minor continuity note, not a reason to reject: the wraps now run further up both forearms than the bible's finger wraps with a bare palm heel (3.1). The brand on the inner left forearm is not in view here anyway.

Minor. Nagoji's hand bandages carry muted brown stains; they read as dirt but could be taken for old blood. The bandage style matches 3.4 but not 3.1. The Fisherman's white cloth hangs from his right shoulder instead of his left. The rock at the left edge looks somewhat like masonry. The beat works: the Fisherman leans in close with his hand at his chin, doing sums, and Nagoji meets his eyes. Nagoji has a clean-shaven chin, thick moustache and gold stud. The off-panel Wary Fisherman's tail goes to the left frame edge, consistent with where he stood in 3.4. There is clear sky across the top for three balloons. v04 puts the Fisherman in a vest, so there is no backup.

v08 is clean. It is wide, with Nagoji up on one elbow (moustache, clean-shaven chin, gold stud, ochre rags, bandaged hands, no irons). The Fisherman crouches in a red lungi with a shoulder cloth, the Young Fisherman stands in an indigo lungi and headband, and the Wary Fisherman holds the net and looks toward the palms, with the wreck in the surf behind. The open grey sky at top centre takes the single balloon. Small note: the Young Fisherman also wears a small ear stud. v07 is not an acceptable backup because all three fishermen wear knitted singlets or tank tops, which are anachronistic and are the reason for this chapter's vest-removal pass.

Acceptable. The bare-chested Fisherman in a red lungi with a white shoulder cloth directs south down a palm-lined coast fading into haze. Nagoji is seen from behind at left (curly hair, gold stud, ochre rag). The open cloudy sky on the right easily holds three balloons. Minor staging drift: the Fisherman is standing and points with his arm instead of jerking his chin, while he crouches in 4.1 and 4.4. The beat still reads. v06 is not an acceptable backup because of the anachronistic cream singlet.

Minor drift only. v05 is the r9 pick (v04) with the hand bandages restored, which matches 4.1, 4.4 and page 3. The brand is also softer: in v04 it is crisp looping cord-ridges that read almost as cursive letters, while in v05 it is a blurred ridged patch that suits 'blurred past reading' better. Remaining: (1) Nagoji sits upright with one knee raised and his left forearm on it, not propped on an elbow as in 4.1 and 4.4. This is a small slip in a close shot. (2) The brand shows on the upper/outer side of the LEFT forearm rather than the inner side. The face is on model: thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin with a stubble shadow, gold stud, long loose curls. He wears the torn ochre tunic over rope-burn lines and the cream dhoti. His alert, waking upward gaze fits the beat. The bandaged hand has a separate thumb and reads as sound. The grey overcast and surf match the page. There is no text and there are no painted boxes. Large open grey sky in the upper right holds both the caption and the one-word balloon clear of the face.

Fix landed: the wreck at the right edge is gone, replaced by matching grey storm sea, surf on dark reef rocks and the green headland; no mast, hull or debris left. A pixel diff against v08 shows changes only in that right-hand sea area, and the faces, poses, bandages and light are unchanged. Nagoji matches the sheet: thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin, small gold ear stud, loose curly hair, ochre rags and cream dhoti. The Fisherman is bare-chested with a shoulder cloth and red lungi. Minor: the brand on Nagoji's left forearm is curly raised ridges that read a little like script but not as legible letters (same as v08). Wide clear storm sky across the top holds all three lines.

The 4.5 fix mostly landed in v11. The Wary Fisherman walking ahead with the net is now older and gaunt. He has thin, ropy arms, a narrow chest, hollow cheeks, long straggly grey-streaked hair hanging past his jaw and a longer, ragged grey-streaked beard, so he now matches 2.4 (v05), 3.3 (v07) and 4.1 (v08) far better than v10's short bushy hair and muscular build. His midriff still shows some segmented rib and ab lines, but they read as a wiry, starved torso rather than a muscular six-pack, the same as in 2.4 and 3.3. He keeps his off-white lungi, brown shoulder cloth, net, walking pose and place in the frame, and his hands are sound. A pixel diff against v10 puts the changes almost entirely in that figure's area (x 1100-1500). The Fisherman, the Young Fisherman, Nagoji, the crab, the beach, the sea and the light are effectively unchanged, so nothing else got worse. Nagoji is unchanged and still matches the sheet: thick curled moustache, light captivity stubble on the chin (which the bible allows), gold ear stud, ochre rags, bandaged hands and no irons. There is no painted text and there are no balloons, European figures or buildings. Open storm sky between the Fisherman and the Young Fisherman, and across the top right, holds both FISHERMAN lines without covering any face.

Clean pick. It is a high, wide shot down the slope. The Fisherman (red lungi, white shoulder cloth) has the shoulders, the Young Fisherman (indigo lungi, headband) the legs, and the Wary Fisherman (off-white lungi, brown shoulder cloth, net) leads. The empty beach, the untouched ship's boat and the small wreck on the reef are all in shot. Nagoji has the clean chin, moustache and gold stud, no irons, and his head is tipped back. One minor point: the Wary Fisherman's hand brushes Nagoji's foot. The two captions fit over the sea and sky at top right and the foliage at top left. v09 is not kept as a backup because it puts the Young and Wary Fishermen in modern tank-top vests, against the author's 2026-09-30 costume decision.

The 5.2 fix landed. In v08 the girl in the left foreground with her hand to her mouth now wears only an undyed cream draped cloth over one shoulder. Her arm is bare and the red short-sleeved blouse is gone. A difference map against v07 shows the edit stayed on her. Her face, hand, pose, the carry group, the houses, the women and the light are all unchanged, so nothing got worse. Nagoji matches his sheet: thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin, small gold ear studs, torn ochre tunic and cream dhoti, wrist bandages, no irons. The fishermen are bare-chested with shoulder cloths: red lungi with a cream cloth, and indigo lungi with a headband. The women are draped in mundu and upper cloth with water pots. There is no painted text and no painted balloons. Open sky and thatch at the top give clear room for the GIRL balloon. One minor issue remains from v07 and is not new: the child beside the girl still wears an olive short-sleeved stitched top. If the author wants it gone, a later edit could change it to draped cream cloth. Also, the small reddish mark visible on Nagoji's left arm sits near the elbow, not on the inner forearm, but this panel does not need the brand.

Acceptable. The Young Fisherman (headband, faded blue shoulder cloth, indigo lungi) carries the legs and turns sharply left toward the girl, who peeks back in a doorway. The Fisherman has the shoulders. Nagoji has the clean chin, moustache and stud, with no irons, and the lane is the same overcast wet village as 5.2. Minor: the girl wears a beige top here against her red top and cream cloth in 5.2. Both balloons fit over the thatch and grey sky above the Young Fisherman. v06 is rejected for tank-top vests.

The fix landed. In v11 the Woman's hair has gone from mostly dark grey-black (v10) to silver grey with only some dark strands left, so it is now more grey than black. It is still pulled back low, which matches 5.5 v06 and 6.1 v10. The top of her head is inside the frame. Her face, dark betel-red lips, faint half-smile and undyed cotton are unchanged. A pixel diff shows the change is almost entirely in her hair, with only slight compression-level noise elsewhere, so nothing else got worse. The rest of the panel still meets the checks. Nagoji has a thick curled moustache, a clean-shaven chin and a small gold drop at the ear. The brand on his near forearm is a pale puckered patch above the bandaged wrist: no letters, no cross, no irons. The Fisherman (red lungi, shoulder cloth) is gesturing mid-speech and the Young Fisherman (indigo lungi, headband) carries his legs. There is no painted text. Lettering space: the open grey sky top-left (above and left of the Fisherman's head) and the dark doorway right of the Woman's head. Minor, carried over from v10: the ear ornament is a small drop rather than a flat stud.

Acceptable, with notes. v06 is the v05 composition with the brand added, and it fixes the one gap v05 had: the brand now shows. Brand: a pale, puckered patch of raised ridges on the forearm he holds out to the Woman, which is his LEFT, about a hand's width above the wrist. It has no numerals and is not a cross. Its three ridge-strokes suggest letterforms (roughly 'L-c-u' when zoomed). At 1:1 and at print size they read as a burned-letter scar, not a word. This is the same level of letter suggestion as the scrolled monogram accepted in 5.4 v02, but the two shapes differ. The arm is turned so the brand sits more on the upper or thumb side than clearly on the inner side. The light is warm hearth light rather than 'cool'. There is a faint shadow under Nagoji's lower lip, within 'light stubble at most'. Everything else matches the beat. The interior is dim, with hearth smoke rising into the lit hole in the thatch. The ochre tunic lies peeled off in a pile on the woven mat. He wears the cream dhoti, and red rope burns cross his bare chest with no blood. The Woman has a grey-streaked low knot and undyed cotton over both shoulders, with no blouse and no gold. She washes his arm over a clay basin with his fingers hidden in her wet cloth, her mouth pulled tight. The Fisherman, in red lungi and shoulder cloth, squats at the mat's edge. Nagoji is on model: thick curled moustache, clean chin, gold ear drop, no irons. Anatomy and hands are sound. No painted text, balloons or boxes. Lettering: the FISHERMAN balloon fits on the plain mud wall at upper left, beside and above his head. The NAGOJI balloon fits in the dark roof beams at top centre, between his hair and the smoke column. Both read left to right in script order.

Clean. The Woman wrings the cloth into a clay basin with a sharp expression, the bare-chested Fisherman (red lungi, cloth on his left shoulder) relays it with a half smile, and Nagoji (curled moustache, clean chin, gold stud, bandaged forearm) lies on the mat in the foreground. The hearth room matches 5.5. The large plain wall above the heads takes both balloons. v08 is the same image, but the Fisherman wears a modern-looking tank top, which the author ruled out on 2026-09-30, so it is not a backup.

Acceptable with minor points. The boy in the doorway, backlit by grey daylight with one hand on the frame, is panting and talking. The Fisherman (red lungi, white cloth on his left shoulder) and the Young Fisherman (indigo lungi, headband, faded blue cloth) are bare-chested. However, both men turn toward the boy instead of looking at each other. The rendering is more photographic than the painted neighbouring panels, and this corner of the house (ropes, nets) looks different from the plain hearth wall in 6.1. Rain falls outside and the floor near the door is wet, which matches 6.3 and 6.4. The dark wall at upper centre and right holds the boy's balloon and the caption. v07 has both men in modern tank tops, so it is rejected.

Clean. The bare-chested Fisherman, crouched by the mat in his red lungi, reaches across with his right hand to adjust the white cloth on his own left shoulder; his hand and arm anatomy holds up. Nagoji on the mat (moustache, clean stubbled chin, gold stud, bandaged wrists, rope marks on his chest) looks up at him. Minor: Nagoji's fingers show uncovered past the wrist bandages. Lettering can go on the thatch band across the top, the mud wall left of Nagoji's head and the sky on the right. v06 has the Fisherman in a vest, so it is rejected.

Acceptable. This is a full-width tier: Nagoji sits with his eyes closed and hearth light on his face (moustache, clean chin, gold stud), with bandaged wrists and fingers. Behind him, the softened Fisherman and Young Fisherman (bare-chested, with their cloths) turn toward the door, and a broad human shadow falls across the floor from the doorway. Minor: the brand on the inner left forearm is drawn pinkish and raw rather than as a pale ridged patch, though there is no blood. There is also a faint extra scar line near the left elbow. The dark wall across the top takes both captions. v09 has both fishermen in vests, so it is rejected.

Acceptable. The camera is low beside the mat. The kapitan matches his sheet: white turban, short grey-flecked beard, pale pocketed vest over a white mundu, no coat. He is in three-quarter view with his left cheek toward camera and a thin scar from his left ear to his jaw, and he looks down at Nagoji. Nagoji (moustache, clean chin, gold stud) looks straight back. His left forearm lies inner side up toward the kapitan with the ridged brand showing. The bare-chested Young Fisherman (headband, indigo lungi) and Fisherman (red lungi, white cloth) stand behind. Minor: the opening shows a dry overcast beach, while 6.4 shows rain. The scars on Nagoji's chest are reddish lines. Heights are hard to judge in this depth. The large plain wall at upper left takes all three captions. v09 has the fishermen in vests, so it is rejected.
